name: Last Days
overview: Scripture reveals that the last days are marked by increased knowledge and global activity, as Daniel 12:4 describes many running to and fro with knowledge increasing. The gospel of the kingdom will be preached worldwide as a witness to all nations before the end comes (Matthew 24:14). During this time, God will pour out His Spirit on all people, inspiring prophecy, visions, and dreams (Acts 2:17). However, the timing of these events remains known only to the Father (Matthew 24:36), while warnings of moral decline and judgment, exemplified by the fate of Sodom and Gomorrah (Jude 1:7), and the rise of deceptive powers demanding allegiance (Revelation 13:16), underscore the spiritual challenges of the last days.
